scheme: Job IDs are shared with the career-ops tool and never overlap.
authority: career-ops max ID lives in ~/PROJECTS/career-ops/data/applications.md (leading integer of each row) and its data/pipeline.md (#NNN).
assign_rule: Before assigning IDs in a scrape, re-read career-ops' max ID. Set next_id to max(career_ops_max + 1, this file's next_id). Assign sequentially in discovery order, increment next_id, never reuse. Write the assigned id into each seen_jobs.json entry, the tracker row, and the archived job_posting.md header.
conflict_rule: career-ops always wins a collision. The two tools sometimes run in parallel and land on the same IDs. At the start of every scrape, and whenever a collision is noticed: read all IDs career-ops now holds; for any ai-job-search ID that career-ops uses for a DIFFERENT job (different URL), renumber the ai-job-search job to a fresh ID above the combined max and propagate to seen_jobs.json, job_search_tracker.csv and the job_posting.md header. Same ID for the same posting URL is not a conflict. Never renumber a career-ops job; never reuse a vacated ai-job-search ID. Full procedure in CLAUDE.md.
